titles.title: Arctic Coastal Plain Public Lands Leasing Act of 1989
Arctic Coastal Plain Public Lands Leasing Act of 1989

A bill to amend the Mineral Lands Leasing Act of 1920 to authorize the Secretary of the Interior to lease, in an expeditious and environmentally sound manner, the public lands within the Coastal Plain of the North Slope of Alaska for oil and gas exploration, development, and production.
